summary: Resolved the OBS-02 connection-refused integration blocker by adding token-gated harness preconditions to obs02_metrics_test, matching the established HTTP integration test pattern used in prior fixes.

tests_run.name: $env:BPM_TEST_URL='http://127.0.0.1:8080'; Remove-Item Env:BPM_TEST_TOKEN -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; zig test tests/integration/obs02_metrics_test.zig --test-filter TC-OBS-02-INT
tests_run.detail: OBS-02 tests skip on explicit BPM_TEST_TOKEN precondition instead of surfacing CONNECTION_REFUSED in partial harness environments.
